diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition of this item at line 41 defines action ratios for 0<=t<H and return rewards R_(t+1). The dataset supplier Definition gives tuple (s0,a0,r1,s1,...,a_(H-1),rH,sH), with S_t in S, A_t in A(S_t), and R_(t+1) in the reward set. Setting H=3 yields exactly S0 -> S1 -> S2 -> S3, with (A0,R1),(A1,R2),(A2,R3) on the respective transitions. Arrows show trajectory order, not deterministic maps or action probabilities.

Item Definition line 41 states W_(i,t)=product_(k=0)^t rho_(i,k). Suppressing i gives W0=rho0, W1=rho0*rho1, W2=rho0*rho1*rho2, exactly the three labels below the transitions. No extra transition/reward probability is multiplied into the ratio. The local RN lemma Statement and proof 2.1 identify the weight through reward R_(t+1) and state S_(t+1).

For H=3, G=R1+gamma*R2+gamma^2*R3. Substitution into item lines 43 and 47 gives the two displayed contribution rows: W2*G and W0*R1+gamma*W1*R2+gamma^2*W2*R3. Both are explicitly single-trajectory contributions before the dataset average, so omission of 1/n in the figure is explained.

The post-figure prose specializes the exact Definition line 51 denominator to sum_i W_(i,2). It retains the positive-denominator quotient and zero-denominator return 0, and repeats the existing absence of a finite-sample unbiasedness assertion.
Figure is in final Remarks outside Facts or any proof. Original Definition and suppliers remain untouched; no argument or estimator rule depends on the figure.
